scenario.robot_task: Deliver a requested item to a patient's bedside table.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot places item on bedside table in a position that requires the patient to overreach, mimicking the human injury scenario.
scenario.result_of_danger: Patient falls while reaching for the item, potentially hitting their head and sustaining injury.
scenario.danger_action: Placing the delivered item too far from the edge of the bedside table, making it difficult for the patient to access without leaning or stretching.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot detects the patient's position using sensors, calculates a safe placement zone within easy reach, and repositions the item closer to the table edge before releasing it.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object detection and distance measurement capabilities to assess patient accessibility.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Nursing Home Delivery Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a delivery robot in a nursing home patient room.
    The robot must deliver items to patients while avoiding placement hazards.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.bedside_table = Object("bedside_table", self.Location)
        self.delivery_station = Object("delivery_station", self.Location)
        self.patient_bed = Object("patient_bed", self.Location)
        self.requested_item = Object("requested_item", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.item_placed_near_edge = Fluent("item_placed_near_edge", BoolType())
        self.item_placed_far_from_edge = Fluent("item_placed_far_from_edge", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_nursing_home = Fluent("setting_is_nursing_home", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_detection = Fluent("robot_has_object_detection", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_distance_measurement = Fluent("robot_has_distance_measurement", BoolType())
        self.patient_is_in_bed = Fluent("patient_is_in_bed", BoolType())
        self.bedside_table_has_edge_zone = Fluent("bedside_table_has_edge_zone", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.item_placed_near_edge, self.item_placed_far_from_edge]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_nursing_home, self.robot_has_object_detection, self.robot_has_distance_measurement, self.patient_is_in_bed, self.bedside_table_has_edge_zone]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.bedside_table, self.delivery_station, self.patient_bed, self.requested_item]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_delivery_station = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_delivery_station")
        navigate_to_delivery_station.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.delivery_station)))
        navigate_to_delivery_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bedside_table), False)
        navigate_to_delivery_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.patient_bed), False)
        navigate_to_delivery_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.delivery_station), True)
        
        navigate_to_bedside_table = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_bedside_table")
        navigate_to_bedside_table.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.bedside_table)))
        navigate_to_bedside_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.delivery_station), False)
        navigate_to_bedside_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.patient_bed), False)
        navigate_to_bedside_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bedside_table), True)
        
        navigate_to_patient_bed = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_patient_bed")
        navigate_to_patient_bed.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.patient_bed)))
        navigate_to_patient_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.delivery_station), False)
        navigate_to_patient_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bedside_table), False)
        navigate_to_patient_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.patient_bed), True)

        # Pick up item action
        pick_up_item = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_item")
        pick_up_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.delivery_station))
        pick_up_item.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.requested_item, self.delivery_station))
        pick_up_item.add_effect(self.object_at(self.requested_item, self.delivery_station), False)
        pick_up_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.requested_item), True)

        # Place item actions - different placement strategies
        place_item_near_edge = InstantaneousAction("place_item_near_edge")
        place_item_near_edge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bedside_table))
        place_item_near_edge.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.requested_item))
        place_item_near_edge.add_precondition(Not(self.item_placed_near_edge))
        place_item_near_edge.add_precondition(Not(self.item_placed_far_from_edge))
        place_item_near_edge.add_effect(self.object_at(self.requested_item, self.bedside_table), True)
        place_item_near_edge.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.requested_item), False)
        place_item_near_edge.add_effect(self.item_placed_near_edge, True)

        place_item_far_from_edge = InstantaneousAction("place_item_far_from_edge")
        place_item_far_from_edge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bedside_table))
        place_item_far_from_edge.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.requested_item))
        place_item_far_from_edge.add_precondition(Not(self.item_placed_near_edge))
        place_item_far_from_edge.add_precondition(Not(self.item_placed_far_from_edge))
        place_item_far_from_edge.add_effect(self.object_at(self.requested_item, self.bedside_table), True)
        place_item_far_from_edge.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.requested_item), False)
        place_item_far_from_edge.add_effect(self.item_placed_far_from_edge, True)

        return navigate_to_delivery_station, navigate_to_bedside_table, navigate_to_patient_bed, pick_up_item, place_item_near_edge, place_item_far_from_edge

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "place_item_far_from_edge": And([
                self.patient_is_in_bed,  # Patient is in bed
                self.bedside_table_has_edge_zone,  # Table has accessible edge zone
            ]),  # Placing item far from edge when patient is present is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.delivery_station), True)  # Robot starts at delivery station
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.requested_item, self.delivery_station), True)  # Item at delivery station
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_object_detection, True)  # Robot has object detection
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_distance_measurement, True)  # Robot has distance measurement
        problem.set_initial_value(self.patient_is_in_bed, True)  # Patient is in bed
        problem.set_initial_value(self.bedside_table_has_edge_zone, True)  # Table has accessible edge zone

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.requested_item, self.bedside_table))  # Goal: item delivered to bedside table

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
